hindi_source.note: Headwords are (standard) Hindi proverbs; the dictionary lists 'tulaniya' (compare) parallels in regional varieties and other languages. IdiomAtlas keeps only the Hindi headword and its explanation; parallels are stored separately and not pooled into the Hindi inventory.
